_comment: Example per-deployment bot config (#253). Copy to config/tenants.json and adjust. The bot loads this at boot; the tenant never reads it. `tenants[name].url` is the tenant service's /events endpoint; `auth_env` is the NAME of the env var on the bot host holding the shared bearer secret (resolved at dispatch). `routes` is keyed by Slack team_id (workspace_id) — most-specific-wins: routes[team].channels[channel] beats routes[team].default. `home.auth_env` is forwarded to the tenant verbatim; the tenant resolves the secret against its own env.
